historical_record.description: Designed by Kenneth MacDonald Jr. and George Adrian Applegarth. One of six houses the partnership designed on Presidio Terrace.
Built by Fernando Nelson in the manner of an English Elizabethan cottage, on a double-wide lot; the design is credited to Applegarth & White.

unknowns: The volume credits the design to Applegarth & White in the project list and to MacDonald & Applegarth in the narrative.
